newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, PUT SRI LANKA IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, PUT SRI LANKA IN TO BAT.

text.p: India won the toss and put Sri Lanka in to bat on Sunday in the first of three one-day internationals at Colombo's R. Premadasa stadium.

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Marvan Atapattu, Aravinda de Silva, Roshan Mahanama, Hashan Tillekeratne, Lanka de Silva, Kumar Dharmasena, Chaminda Vaas, Muthiah Muralitharan, Sajeeva de Silva.
India - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Nayan Mongia, Rajesh Chauhan, Anil Kumble, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruvila.
